history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A close-up, low-angle selfie of a young man with dark, messy hair and fair skin. He is wearing a light blue, chunky knit sweater. His mouth is slightly open, and he is looking directly at the camera with a surprised or questioning expression. The lighting is dramatic, with strong sunlight casting shadows across his face and the background, creating a high-contrast effect. Behind him, there are dark brown closet doors with vertical handles, and a white ceiling with a square light fixture.
